analysis.purpose: The memory recall core: ranks eligible remembered claims for a query, surfaces conflicting claims together, and stays free of any storage engine so it can be reasoned about in isolation.
responsibilities: Filter to records that are currently eligible for recall
Rank candidates against the query using a multi-criterion comparator
Group conflicting claims so a disagreement is visible rather than hidden

businessRules.rule: The recall core takes its lexical relevance signal through a port, so it stays free of any database dependency.
businessRules.rationale: Keeps the ranking logic unit-testable in isolation from storage.

businessRules.rule: Conflicting claims are returned together rather than silently picking a winner.
businessRules.rationale: A hidden conflict is how stale memory quietly misleads an agent.

nodes.name: Memory recall
nodes.summary: Eligibility, ranking and conflict surfacing for memory.

edges.rationale: This file is the recall core.
